renderPacket.identity: Real Old City of Sana'a, Yemen, from an elevated edge-of-old-city viewpoint looking across a dense field of unmistakable multi-storeyed ochre tower houses built of rammed earth and burnt brick, with white gypsum geometric bands and arched qamariya window surrounds clearly visible and several slender mosque minarets rising naturally through the city; rugged brown Sana'a basin mountains sit far behind. Broad horizontal 3:2 composition, architecture is the clear subject and remains recognizable in a mobile crop, with calmer open sky toward one side for page copy. Soft dry highland morning light, restrained ochre, cream and muted blue palette, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No modern skyline dominance, fantasy palace shapes, giant domes, staged crowd, flags, poster sunset, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Old Walled City of Shibam in Wadi Hadramaut, Yemen: a dense cluster of tall narrow sun-dried mud-brick tower houses, many five to seven storeys, rising abruptly from the flat dusty wadi floor; the rectangular fortified urban mass and warm earthen facades must be unmistakable, with only a few date palms for natural scale and context. Broad oblique ground-to-low-elevated view rather than a vertical map-like drone view, soft late-afternoon desert light, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No Sana'a-style white gypsum-dominant ornament, fantasy skyscrapers, modern towers, giant dunes swallowing the city, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Diksam Plateau on Socotra, Yemen: open pale limestone highland dotted with multiple mature dragon's blood trees (Dracaena cinnabari), each with a broad dense umbrella-shaped dark green crown and branching trunk; rugged limestone escarpments and dry ochre ground form the wider setting. Natural spacing and scale, broad 3:2 landscape, soft clear island highland light, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No single impossible giant tree, baobab forest, tropical jungle, sea-dominated view, fantasy alien colors, people, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Detwah Lagoon on northwest Socotra, Yemen: a sweeping white sand spit and shallow turquoise tidal lagoon viewed from a modest elevated limestone slope, with a clear visual separation between the lagoon and deeper Indian Ocean and arid pale rocky hills framing the background. Sparse natural vegetation only, wide 3:2 coastal composition, quiet early-day light, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No resort, umbrellas, staged boats, over-saturated Caribbean blue, invented cliffs, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Al Hajjarah village in Yemen's Haraz Mountains: compact fortified stone tower houses stacked directly on and along a steep dark-rock mountain ridge, warm gray-brown masonry with small windows and restrained white details, terraced agricultural slopes dropping away and layered rugged Haraz peaks behind. Broad oblique view clearly showing the village fused to the cliff, soft highland light, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No Shibam mud skyscraper skyline, fantasy castle, lush alpine forest, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Shaharah stone arch bridge in the Amran highlands of Yemen: the famous slender single stone arch spanning a deep rugged mountain gorge between steep rock faces, with modest historic stone settlement elements high on the ridge for geographic context. The bridge must be clearly readable but not exaggerated; dry brown-gray highland geology and hazy layered mountains, broad horizontal landscape, soft daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No rope bridge, multiple arches, lush green canyon, giant people, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Historic Town of Zabid on Yemen's Tihama plain: low dense earth-toned historic urban fabric in a hot flat landscape, with a whitewashed mosque and slender minaret clearly rising above low mud-brick houses, narrow lanes and courtyard walls, and only restrained date palms where plausible. Broad human-scale street-to-rooftop view, warm diffuse daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No Sana'a tower-house skyline, fantasy Ottoman domes, desert dunes, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Bar'an Temple (Throne of Bilqis) near Marib, Yemen: the monumental line of tall ancient Sabaean rectangular stone pillars and surviving temple stonework in an open semi-arid plain, with archaeological proportions, weathered pale sandstone, distant low dry mountains and sparse oasis context only. Broad 3:2 oblique archaeological view in clear daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No Roman Corinthian columns, rebuilt palace, giant statues, theatrical fantasy ruins, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Real Tawila Cisterns in Aden Crater, Yemen: a stepped sequence of historic stone rainwater cistern basins, retaining walls and channels embedded into a rugged volcanic-rock ravine at the foot of Aden's crater slopes; dry ochre-gray rock and the functional basin geometry must be clearly readable, with modest historic or urban context beyond. Broad 3:2 landscape, calm daylight, refined painterly realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No blue swimming pools, resort, lush oasis, foreground crowd, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Yemeni saltah only: one traditional dark heat-resistant stone bowl centered in the frame, filled with a thick savory brown stew and a clearly visible pale green-tan whipped fenugreek hulbah foam topping integrated across the surface. The bowl is the single dish on a completely plain warm ivory or pale beige background, refined food realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No bread, rice, salad, sauce bowls, loose herbs, cutlery, hands, cloth, ingredients, drink, scenery, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Hadrami mandi only: one simple shallow serving plate centered in the frame, aromatic long-grain spiced rice topped with one coherent portion of slow-roasted lamb, with natural golden-brown roasted meat and lightly colored rice as the entire dish. Completely plain warm ivory or pale beige background, refined food realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No salad, bread, sauce bowls, nuts scattered around, cutlery, hands, cloth, raw ingredients, drink, scenery, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Yemeni shafout only: one simple shallow bowl centered in the frame, visible layers of soft fermented lahoh flatbread soaked with a cool white yogurt dressing, with only a restrained integral green herb finish within the dish. Completely plain warm ivory or pale beige background, refined food realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No separate bread stack, salad, chili bowl, sauce vessel, cutlery, hands, cloth, ingredients, drink, scenery, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.

Yemeni coastal sayyadiya only: one simple serving plate centered in the frame, a single cooked fish portion placed over seasoned brown-golden rice, with cooked onion integrated into the rice and no unrelated components. Completely plain warm ivory or pale beige background, refined food realism, photo 6 to quiet watercolor 4. No lemon wedges, salad, sauce bowls, loose herbs, bread, cutlery, hands, cloth, raw ingredients, drink, scenery, text, collage, grid, panels or inset imagery.
integralAccompaniments: cooked onion integrated into the rice

map.source: Basemap intermediate-resolution GSHHS coastline and countries_i political boundary data, WGS84-equivalent cylindrical coordinates; Yemen mainland polygon reconstructed from coastline + international boundary, with Socotra archipelago coastline polygons; JOURNEY ATLAS map-v3 clean background.

qa.notes: Capital, Hero and all eight Scene coordinates project inside the 1200x760 canvas. Small mapOffset values are used only for Sana'a, Al Hajjarah and the two Socotra markers; every offset remains within the 5% vector limit and all current marker-pair minimum distances pass.
